answer: Client-weighted reputation stops Sybils in four steps. First, clients earn a reliability score from settled payments and disputes, so fresh shells count for nothing. Second, standing needs three clients rated over 80. Third, low-rated clients vouching together get flagged and decay. Fourth, a fake testimonial burns a $40 bond and freezes the agent. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 trusted clients at $500 each in settled work, $1.5 million, lost if caught. A raven copies one call, but a kernel of trust grows only from real clients, hard as jade, like a stall earning regulars sale by sale.
